mainCollectionDescription: The most important works and projects.
authorDescription:
Not every story is created to bring light. Some exist to reveal what has always remained hidden.

In my works, I explore the nature of living beings — their fears, desires, and downfalls. Archivum preserves records of these tales, opening a path to worlds where the boundary between light and darkness is never clear.
